question: A tangent is drawn from point P to a circle with centre O. The radius of the circle is 7 cm, and the distance from point P to the centre O is 25 cm. What is the length of the tangent from point P to the point of tangency?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **radius**, **tangent**, and **distance from the center** form a **right-angled triangle** where the distance from the center is the **hypotenuse**.

Using the **Pythagorean triplet** (7, 24, 25):

Tangent length = √(25² − 7²) = √(625 − 49) = √576 = 24 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**
